scope: Proposition 6.2 (Uniform programmable synthesis) of the manuscript “Polynomial-Time Unitary Synthesis from a Boolean Oracle” (preprints/Polynomial-Time-Unitary-Synthesis-from-a-Boolean-Oracle-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 283 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 198849e472386b7a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 1, 1 ≤ d ≤ 2n, and t ≥ 0. There is a programmable-slot circuit structure, determined by n, d, t, with the following property. For every family (Uλ)λ∈{0,1}t of unitaries on Cd, its slot tables can be chosen so that the circuit implements the controlled unitary Uλ, preserves the labels, and has clean-workspace operator norm error less than 1/100 in the sense of (2.1). The circuit uses t + O((n + 1)10 ) qubits, O((n + 1)13 ) slots. (6.4) Its structure, including each slot’s ordered control list, is generated deterministically in time polyno- mial in n + t from n, d, t.
